sentiment.instructions: How does the author of this text feel overall?

positive.description: The author feels good about something, such as pleased, happy, grateful, hopeful or approving.
examples: Not even 20 pages into Paper Towns and the book centers around the night of May 5th. I know its gonna be a good one now!

neutral.description: The author shows no particular feeling or only passes on information.
examples: I may be sleep deprived but I promise you that some kid at Dunkin today looked like a sprout.

negative.description: The author feels bad about something, such as angry, sad, worried, disappointed or disapproving.
examples: The tragedy of only thinking up hilarious tweets for the Summer Olympics now is that in four years there may be no place for them.
